title: An invoiced work order with an inactive part can be viewed and printed
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-OLDWO-01) was tracked at {Location-A} with Sell Price $20.00 when it was sold.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is invoiced and its line {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL OLDWO line") sold {Part-A}, quantity 1 at $20.00, today.
  • {Part-A} was set inactive after the invoice was created.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1} and read its Lines tab.
  2. Open the Finance tab and read the invoice.
  3. Click the print icon on the Finance tab.
  4. Go to Reports → Parts Velocity, set a date range that includes today and search {Part-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Work-order-1} opens and {Line-1} shows {Part-A}.
  • Step 2: The invoice shows {Part-A}, 1 × $20.00.
  • Step 3: The print preview opens and lists {Part-A}.
  • Step 4: The report lists {Part-A} with a sold quantity of 1.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-E4, S9-E11, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows an invoiced work order. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-E4: “Completed and invoiced work orders that hold an inactive part stay viewable, printable and reportable.”
  • S9-E11: “Reports keep inactive parts. Inventory Value and Parts Velocity include them, because their stock still has value and their history still happened.”
